description: This file defines a Java interface for a repository managing ScheduledJobDetail entities, including methods for querying, locking, and retrieving job details in a Fineract-based application.

classes.name: ScheduledJobDetailRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing ScheduledJobDetail entities, providing custom queries for retrieving job details, locks, and existence checks.

methods.name: findByJobKey
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail entity by its job key.

methods.name: findByJobId
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail entity by its numeric ID.

methods.name: findByJobKeyWithLock
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail by job key with a pessimistic write lock.

methods.name: findAllMismatchedJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all ScheduledJobDetail entities marked as mismatched jobs.

methods.name: findAllJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs for a given node ID, including those with node ID zero.

methods.name: findByJobName
methods.description: Finds a ScheduledJobDetail by its job name.

methods.name: getDataById
methods.description: Retrieves detailed job data for a specific job ID.

methods.name: getDataByShortName
methods.description: Retrieves detailed job data for a given short name.

methods.name: getAllData
methods.description: Retrieves data for all scheduled jobs.

methods.name: existsByShortName
methods.description: Checks if a job with the given short name exists.

methods.name: findIdByShortName
methods.description: Finds the ID associated with a given short name.
